---
title: "Background Removal Model Training"
format: html
---

Training **background removal** model for petrographic analysis.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(petrographer)
library(hipergator)

# Configure HPC settings once (optional - can still use .Renviron)
hpg_configure(
  host = "hpg",
  user = Sys.getenv("USER"),
  base_dir = "/blue/nicolas.gauthier/petrographer"
)

# Validate dataset
validate_dataset(here::here("data/processed/background_removal"))
```

## Training

```{r training}
# Train model - HPC settings configured above
# Models are automatically pinned to .petrographer/ board
model_id <- train_model(
  data_dir = here::here("data/processed/background_removal"),
  model_id = "background_removal_v2",
  num_classes = 2
  # Uses defaults: max_iter=12000, device="cuda", eval_period=1000
)
```

## Evaluation

```{r evaluation}
# Training metrics are embedded in the pin metadata
# Access via model_info() or pins::pin_meta()
meta <- model_info(model_id, board = "local")
```

## Model Testing

```{r testing}
cat("\n== Testing Model ==\n")

# Load trained model from local board
model <- from_pretrained(model_id, device = "cuda")

# Test on validation sample
val_images <- dir_ls(path(here::here("data/processed/background_removal"), "val"), 
                        regexp = "(?i)\\.(jpg|jpeg|png)$")

if (length(val_images) > 0) {
  test_image <- val_images[1]
  
  test_result <- predict_image(
    image_path = test_image,
    model = model,
    output_dir = here::here("results", "background_removal_v2_test")
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("Test image: %s\n", path_file(test_image)))
  cat(sprintf("Objects detected: %d\n", nrow(test_result)))
  
  if (nrow(test_result) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("Mean confidence: %.3f\n", mean(test_result$confidence)))
  }
} else {
  cat("Warning: No validation images found for testing\n")
}
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
cat("\n== Training Summary ==\n")

if (exists("test_result") && nrow(test_result) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Model successfully tested with %d detections\n", nrow(test_result)))
}

cat("\n=== Next Steps ===\n")
cat("• Review training convergence\n")
cat("• Test on additional images\n")
cat("• Compare with previous versions\n")
cat("• Archive model in zoo\n")
```
